turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good morning. What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have had fever and cough for three days, doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any body pain or sore throat?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Some body pain. The fever touches 102 at night.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your temperature is 101 now and BP is 120 over 80. Chest is clear.
